topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Hey, you won't believe this, but I just found out that our neighbor, Tom? The one who's always out there in his garden with his old, beat-up lawnmower? Turns out, he's rolling in dough! Like, more money than both of us could spend in a lifetime. I heard it from my cousin who knows someone who works at his investment firm. Wow, right? I guess all those years he's been donating to the community kitchen and sponsoring the local baseball team, he wasn't just being a good guy—he was being a good, rich guy. Makes you wonder what else we don't know about the people around us, doesn’t it? But you know what? It’s kind of nice. Reminds me there’s more to people than what meets the eye.
